# Semantic roles

This is the contract every port honors. A port maps each role to something in its target app;
it never invents colors of its own. See [SPEC.md](SPEC.md) for the rules of use.

## Surfaces

| Role | Meaning | Canindé |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bg.base` | Main canvas: editor and terminal background | `#11161E` |
| `bg.sunken` | Chrome that sits below the canvas: sidebar, activity bar, title bar, inactive tabs | `#060C13` |
| `bg.raised` | Slightly lifted areas: line highlight, hovered rows, panel headers | `#1E252D` |
| `bg.overlay` | Floating UI: menus, dropdowns, suggestion lists, notifications | `#1E252D` |
| `bg.hover` | Hover and inactive-selection background | `#2D333C` |
| `bg.active` | Pressed or active background | `#474E57` |
